== Notes ==

* Heroes do not cast this enchantment between battles, though they maintain it reliably during combat.
* This skill can ''lower'' the strength of signets, since the Fast Casting rank is used, even when the linked attribute has a greater rank.
* Symbolic Celerity works with signets linked to title tracks.
